title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Aerodactyl Pokemon 151 142/165 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and sought-after Pokémon Card TCG features the powerful Aerodactyl in stunning holo finish. With a card number of 142/165, this Japanese card is a must-have for any serious collector of the Pokémon 151 set. The card is in excellent shape and has been well-preserved, ensuring its long-lasting value. 

The card is perfect for fans of the Pokémon TCG game, with its colorless attribute and no autograph. It is manufactured by Nintendo in Japan and features the iconic character Aerodactyl. This card is an excellent addition to any collection and is sure to impress both avid collectors and casual fans alike.
